words.def: to get away from a place or a situation; an occasion when you get away
to stay alive after an accident or a very dangerous event
to go somewhere where nobody can see or find you
to stay on the surface of water, or to move slowly through the air
below the surface of the water
the top of the water, where it meets the air
the air that goes into and out of your lungs
the lower part of the face, that moves when you eat or speak
not strong; without much power or energy
having a sharp taste, like a lemon
a very large green fruit that is red and full of water inside

to move so that you are facing the other way

to speak very quietly so that only one person can hear
normal; not special or unusual in any way

steps.title: Listen once. Choose the best summary.
options: A man got lost on a mountain and was found the same evening.
A man broke his leg on a mountain and stayed alive for over three weeks before he was found.
A man fell from a cable car and was rescued by his friends.
A man walked down a mountain and reached his hotel safely.
steps.answer: A man broke his leg on a mountain and stayed alive for over three weeks before he was found.

steps.title: Write the first four sentences of your story.
Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ talk about an accident or an escape — survive, be stuck, knock into, scream, disappear
✓ tell the events of a story in the past simple, in order
✓ set the scene with the past continuous — While I was…
✓ step back to an earlier event with the past perfect — He had already…
✓ tell the listener how to take it — Luckily, Sadly, Remarkably, Curiously
✓ choose between the present perfect and the past simple recycled
